Answer: A
Reason: Figure 1 (axial CT at the thoracic inlet) clearly demonstrates a soft tissue mass in the left apex adjacent to the second rib with evident osseous destruction/erosion of the rib, which is a characteristic feature of recurrent hemangiopericytoma (solitary fibrous tumor). The other options describe locations (epidiaphragmatic, pulmonary ligament) or morphologies (smooth margins, no rib involvement) that do not match the destructive apical lesion shown.
